task.title: P6-090: Hoist CardPreview's pointer-type detection into one shared context
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-090. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Hoist `CardPreview`'s pointer-type detection into one shared context** — it runs a `match_media` Effect + signal per instance (`cards.rs:284-297`, ~60 per catalog page, four call sites) for a global fact, and has **no `MediaQueryList` change listener**, so a convertible flipping modes mid-session keeps the stale arrangement. Cost multiplies as more surfaces adopt `CardPreview`.
